name: File Editor (TypeScript)
description: Advanced file editor with TypeScript implementation, syntax highlighting, and full DynamicWorkspace compatibility

_discovery.describe: Advanced file editor with syntax highlighting and TypeScript implementation. Supports multiple programming languages (markdown, JSON, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, YAML, etc.) with Monaco editor integration. Full DynamicWorkspace compatibility with real-time updates. Includes features like auto-save, line numbers, code folding, and find/replace. Instant file loading and editing (~100ms for typical files). Perfect for editing configuration files, scripts, documentation, and code during development workflows.
use_cases: Quick file editing without external tools
